scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @shopsphere/api" "npm run dev -w @shopsphere/web"

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @shopsphere/api && npm run typecheck -w @shopsphere/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @shopsphere/api && npm run test -w @shopsphere/web
